jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Title: Data Analyst
Company:
Clinisol Tech Inc.
Employment Type:
Full-Time, W2 (deployed to client projects)
Experience:
2–3 years
Compensation:
$60,000–$90,000 per year (Negotiable)
Work Mode:
On-Site / Hybrid
Work Authorization
Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.
Why This Role?
Join Clinisol Tech Inc. to turn data into actionable business insights. Work on real-world client projects, build dashboards, analyze trends, and help organizations make data-driven decisions while developing your skills in SQL, Excel, and business intelligence tools.
Job Summary
Clinisol Tech Inc. is seeking a detail-oriented Data Analyst
with 2–3 years of experience in data analysis, reporting, and dashboard development. The ideal candidate will be comfortable extracting, cleaning, validating, and analyzing data to identify trends and provide meaningful insights to business stakeholders.
Key Responsibilities
Extract, clean, transform, and analyze data from multiple sources.
Write SQL queries to retrieve, join, aggregate, and validate data.
Develop and maintain dashboards and reports using Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools
.
Use Microsoft Excel for data analysis, pivot tables, formulas, and reporting.
Track key performance indicators (KPIs), identify trends, and investigate discrepancies.
Automate recurring reports and improve reporting efficiency.
Translate business requirements into analytical reports and actionable recommendations.
Collaborate with business, operations, product, and technical teams.
Maintain data accuracy, documentation, and confidentiality.

Qualifications
2–3 years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Reporting, or a related field.
Strong proficiency in SQL and Microsoft Excel
.
Hands-on experience with Power BI, Tableau, or another BI visualization tool
.
Understanding of relational databases, data cleaning, and data-quality principles.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Ability to present complex data clearly and work collaboratively with stakeholders.
Familiarity with Python for data analysis is a plus.

Tools & Technologies
Querying:
SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server
Spreadsheets:
Microsoft Excel, PivotTables, Power Query
Visualization:
Power BI, Tableau, Looker
Programming:
Python, Pandas
Data Platforms:
Snowflake, Amazon Redshift, Google BigQuery

Preferred Skills
Experience with interactive dashboards, KPI reporting, and data visualization.
Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes and data warehousing.
Knowledge of basic statistics, trend analysis, and data modeling.
Experience automating reports and performing data-quality checks.

About Clinisol Tech Inc.
Clinisol Tech Inc. connects businesses with skilled professionals who drive results. We combine industry expertise with a personalized approach to deliver the right talent efficiently. Our mission is to connect exceptional technology talent with innovative organizations that value people.

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description:
Position Summary

PTx is looking for a detail-oriented and business-focused Data Scientist
to support our growing Business Intelligence function. This role blends advanced analytics with strong business acumen. The ideal candidate will enable the organization to make data-driven decisions through clear and actionable insights. The ideal candidate excels in transforming complex datasets into intuitive dashboards, reports, and predictive insights. This role requires the candidate to work with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to understand performance, identify opportunities, and drive strategic outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Partner with business leaders to understand KPIs, performance drivers, and reporting needs.
Develop and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and automated reporting tools to support daily decision-making.
Conduct deep-dive analyses to identify trends, operational gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
Build predictive and descriptive models that enhance business forecasting and performance measurement.
Translate data findings into concise, business-friendly insights, and recommendations.
Support data governance efforts by ensuring data accuracy, consistency, and reliability across systems.
Collaborate with IT and Cloud teams to enhance data pipelines and improve BI data availability.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in data science, Business Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Agriculture, or related field. Or M.S. degree with a strong data analysis background.
Experience in Business Intelligence, analytics, or data science roles supporting business operations.
Proficiency with BI tools such as Tableau or Domo.
Strong SQL skills and experience extracting, cleaning, and transforming data from multiple sources.
Experience using Python or R for statistical analysis or machine learning.
Ability to explain complex analytical concepts in a clear and concise manner to business stakeholders.
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

Preferred Skills

1 - 2 years professional experience
Experience working in Databricks (Lakehouse) environments, including Delta tables, Databricks/Spark SQL, notebooks, and scheduled jobs/workflows.
Ability to integrate and model data from multiple source systems (e.g., ERP/finance, CRM/sales, operations/field systems), including SQL databases, APIs, and flat files.
Familiarity with ETL/ELT patterns in a modern lakehouse stack and effective cross-team collaboration with data engineering on pipelines and data quality.
Knowledge of forecasting, segmentation, and statistical analysis techniques.
Background in financial, operational, or customer analytics.
Experience developing self-service semantic layers, curated datasets, and reporting frameworks that scale across teams.

Your Benefits

Health care and wellness plans
Dental and vision plans
401(k) Savings Plan with company match
Employee Stock Purchase Plan offering eligible employees the ability to purchase AGCO stock at a discounted price
Paid holidays and paid time off
Health savings and flexible spending accounts
Reimbursement for continuing education
Life insurance and other supplemental insurance plans

Your Compensation

This position offers a base salary range of $84,000 - $176,000, with final compensation determined based on experience, skills, and qualifications. This role is also eligible for a target annual bonus eligibility of 8% of base salary, as part of AGCO’s total rewards program.

Your Workplace

This role follows AGCO’s on-site work model, primarily working from the Tremont, IL
or Louisville, CO
location 4 days per week to support collaboration and teamwork.

We value inclusion and recognize the innovation a diverse workforce delivers to our farmers. Through our recruitment efforts, we are committed to building a team that includes a variety of experiences, backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives.

Join our extraordinary team today and apply now!

AGCO is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We maintain a drug-free workplace and perform pre-employment substance abuse testing.

Industries

Machinery Manufacturing and Farming
